title: SmartBroom 2026.10
body:
A major update to SmartBroom brings powerful new session insights, a redesigned live sweeping experience, and expanded multi-device support on iPad.

## All New

An all new session display for SmartBroom 4 shows you graphical overviews of sweep metrics across an entire practice or game. Sessions also gain titles, descriptions, and notes.

Live sweeps now have a new interface, allowing multiple sweepers to easily swap a SmartBroom back and forth.

On iPad you can now open multiple windows and connect to multiple SmartBrooms in parallel.

## Improvements and Fixes

- Performance is improved, especially scrolling through lists of sweep charts.
- Fixes SPI scaling issue
- Fixes x-axis marks in charts
